Backend (pytest): 13/13 passed in test_roles_and_quotas.py incl. owner (role=owner, name=Studio Owner, /api/usage unlimited=true, can_edit=true), judge (role=judge, name=Inkloom Judge, builds_limit=3/chats_limit=15, can_edit=false, sees Chef Notebook with shared=true, GET stages ok, PATCH+DELETE both 403), and registered user (limits 1/5, isolation from owner project 404, ONE real build succeeded, second build -> 429 'daily allowance', 5 chats ok, 6th chat -> 429, usage counters correct). Judge chat on owner project -> 200 and chats_used +1. Frontend (Playwright, preview URL): AuthScreen shows judge-access-card with judge-email/judge-password codes and judge-login-button; body contains NO owner email/password and no auth-fill-demo. One-click judge login lands with sidebar-user-name 'Inkloom Judge', role 'JUDGE · VIEW + TRY', allowance-status like 'TODAY · 3 BUILDS · 14 CHATS LEFT'. Chef Notebook appears in history-list with SHOWCASE shared-tag; opens to workflow-report with 6 stage tabs; project-title-readonly rendered (NO project-title-input); history-delete NOT rendered for the shared item. Sending one chat via chat-input/chat-send-button appended a new chat-message-assistant and decremented allowance 13->12. Owner login via the form gives 'OWNER · UNLIMITED', editable project-title-input, delete buttons on own projects, no SHOWCASE tags. Quick-read (analyze-idea-button), nav-kit, nav-guide, nav-studio, new-project-button all still work. Exhausted-registered-user UI (seeded via Mongo to build=1/chat=5): allowance shows '0 BUILDS · 0 CHATS LEFT', build-brand-system-button text='DAILY BUILDS USED' and disabled, chat-input disabled with placeholder 'Daily chat allowance reached on this account — saved conversation stays viewable.', chat-send-button disabled. No console errors on the happy paths.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py QUOTAS: judge & user daily allowance is enforced per UTC day with a hard 429. Consider surfacing the reset time (e.g. Retry-After header with seconds until 00:00 UTC) for better UX on 429.
server.py visible_user_ids: db.users.find({'role':'owner'}) .to_list(10) hard-caps at 10 owner accounts. Fine for the hackathon (only one owner) but a subtle limit — call out or remove the cap.

server.py list_workflows: 'shared': d['user_id'] != user['id']. Because judges can only see own+owner docs, shared==true implicitly means 'owner-authored', which is what the SHOWCASE tag expects — but this coupling would break if any other role becomes visible later. Consider naming it explicitly (e.g. from_owner).
auth.py seed_demo_user: idempotent update path now updates role+name+password on every startup which is correct; leaves login_attempts intact between deploys (fine).
Frontend App.js loadUsage is refetched on build/chat completion but NOT on rename/delete. That is intentional (no LLM cost) but worth noting.

Frontend IdeaPanel: build button uses `exhausted` from buildsLeft prop but chat-input uses chatsLeft directly through ProjectChat. Both correctly reflect /api/usage; the two disabled reasons render slightly different phrasing which is good UX.

Prior review items from iteration 4 still stand: password minLength=6, IP+email-keyed lockout could be abused behind a shared proxy, and /api/workflow has no client-cancellation guard for the ~90s build.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend role/quota tests: /app/backend/tests/test_roles_and_quotas.py — hits localhost:8001 to avoid Cloudflare UA blocks. It DOES spend one real 6-stage build every run (~140s, 6 LLM calls) and 5 chats on a fresh registered user, plus 1 judge chat on Chef Notebook. If you want to avoid that cost, either mark TestRegisteredUserQuota::test_build_then_second_build_429 with a pytest marker skip or seed db.usage counters manually and skip the POST /api/workflow line. Judge chat total for today is now 3/15 used — if you re-run judge chat tests you have 12 left before 429. Owner unlimited. The frontend exhausted-user test relies on Mongo-seeded usage (see summary), which is the fastest way to validate the disabled-UI states without spending LLM credits.
rca of the issue: No blocking issues. One transient false negative in my initial script (chat did not appear to decrement) was purely a race — I checked allowance-status before the assistant reply arrived and before onChatUpdate->loadUsage completed. Re-running with a proper wait confirmed 13->12 decrement and correct /api/usage refresh.
